title: So Easy! Strawberry Yogurt Bark
text: Body construction crew, snack project starts now! Yogurt brings calcium, a nutrient our bones need!
speaker: Chef Bone

title: Just Two Ingredients
text: Two hundred grams of unsweetened plain low-fat yogurt and about five strawberries. That is all!
speaker: Narrator

title: 01 Wash, Dry, and Slice
text: Wash the strawberries and pat them dry! Slice thinly so they are easier to eat after freezing.
speaker: Chef Bone

title: 02 Spread Thinly and Evenly
text: Line a freezer-safe tray with parchment. Spread the yogurt into a thin, even layer.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03 Add Strawberries and Freeze
text: Press in the strawberry tiles! Cover and freeze for three to four hours, or until completely firm!
speaker: Chef Bone

title: 04 Divide into Small Pieces
text: Let it soften briefly, then divide into small pieces. If it is too hard, wait a little longer.
speaker: Narrator

title: Why Bone Chose Yogurt
text: Yogurt provides calcium. Your body needs calcium to build and maintain strong bones.
speaker: Narrator

title: How Much Calcium per Serving?
text: The serving shown is half of this recipe. Calcium content varies between yogurt products.
speaker: Narrator

title: Snack Construction Complete!
text: Looks sturdy, but this is not flooring! This construction project is finished when we eat it!
speaker: Chef Bone

title: Screenshot Your Next Snack
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Bone
